main_text.p: Fortior fuisti me, Jer.20.7. Infinit. לְחֻזְקָה Ut confirmetur illud, Ezech.30.21. Imper. חֲזַק וְחַזֵּק Confirmare & con-firmare, id est, Etiam atq; etiam confirmare & recolligere, Dan.10.19. Pih. חִזֵּק Firmavit, Confirmavit, Obfir-mavit, Obduravit, Fortificavit, Roboravit, Restaura-vit: Præter. חִזֵּק בְּרִיחָיו Confirmat vectes portarum tua-rum, Psalm.147.13. חִזְקוּ פְּנֵיהֶם Obfirmant facies suas, Jer.5.3. Partic. מְחַזֵּק אֶת לֵב Obfirmo cor Pharaonis, Exod. 14.v.17. Infinit. לְחַזֵּק הַבַּיִת Ad confirmandum sive restau-randum domum, 2.Par.34.10. Hiph. הֶחֱזִיק Idem; atq; ita cum Accusativo construitur: sed frequentius est, Appre-hendit, Comprehendit, Tenuit, Detinuit, Retinuit, firmiter & per vim: & sæpius construitur cum Præposit. ב: Præter. לֹא הֶחֱזִיק לָעַד אַפּוֹ Non retinet in æternum iram suam, Mich.7.18. Fœm. וְהֶחֱזִיקָה בּוֹ Et prehendit eum, Prov.7.13. Part. מַחֲזִיק בָּם Vi detinens cos, Exod.9.2. Infin. בְּיוֹם הַחֲזִיקִי בִּידָם In die apprehendere me manum eorum, Jeremi.31.32. quod præter morem paroxytonon est, & cum Segol loco Pathach. Futur. וַתַּחֲזֵק בּוֹ Et prehen-dit eum, 2.Reg.4.v.8. Hithp. הִתְחַזֵּק Firmum vel for-tem se exhibuit, Fortificavit aut Confirmavit se, Confirmatus fuit: Præter. וְלֹא הִתְחַזֵּק Et non confir-mavit se, 2.Par.13.7. Imper. הִתְחַזְּקוּ וִהְיוּ לָאֲנָשִׁים Confirmate vos, & estote viri, 1.Sam.4.9.
חָזָק m. Invalescens, Exod.19.19. הָלוֹךְ וְחָזֵק Vadens & invalescens, 2.Sam.3.1. id est, Pergebat invalescere.

חָזָק m. Validus, Valens, Fortis, Robustus, Vehemens: חָזָק הוּא מִמֶּנּוּ Fortior est nobis, Num.13.32. Plur. חֲזָקִים, Jud.18.20. Constr. חָזְקֵי מֵצַח Fortes frontis, i.e. obfirmatâ fronte, Ezech.3.7. Fœm. בְּיַד חֲזָקָה Manu forti, Exod.13.9.
חֹזֶק m. Firmitas: Aff. חָזְקִי Firmitas mea, Psal.18.2.
חֹזֶק m. Robur, Hag.2.23. בְּחֹזֶק יָד In robore manus, Ro-bustâ

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are very small in this scan, so the pointing of the Hebrew forms is read with less certainty than the Latin. The Hebrew letters are reliable. The last entry continues on the right as "bustâ", written here as "Ro-bustâ" after the printed hyphen. No catchword, signature or marginal notes are printed on this page.
